note: `emacs-major-version', the variable a package's version gate reads. Emacs 31.0.91 answers (31 t nil t). kg answers the same, and the equality is a DECISION rather than a coincidence: 31 is the Emacs whose behaviour every contract in this corpus is measured against, so kg never implements an older Emacs' answer for a name and a gate asking `at least N' gets the right answer for every name kg has. dash.el:3980's (< emacs-major-version 25) is the measured consumer -- it guards a font-lock list for pre-25 Emacsen.
